text:
alex: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a lightweight gateway shim to handle /v1 -> /v2 chat migration. Sketch below. TL;DR: prefer gateway shim for opt-in tenant-level translation, less client churn, but extra latency and telemetry complexity. Thoughts?

jamie: +1 on avoiding client churn. can we keep it disabled by default and opt tenants in?

alex: yes, opt-in + tenant flag. rollout plan: opt-in in staging -> opt-in in canary -> subset of prod tenants -> full ramp. fallback to v1 if translation fails.

nina: curious about telemetry — if we translate requests we lose original shape. need to emit original+translated payloads for debugging but redact tokens. privacy check?

sofia: agree with nina. also we should avoid adding per-request synchronous work in the hot path. can the shim be async-translate for non-low-latency routes?

jamie: latency impact is my main concern. if shim adds 20-50ms p99 for small chats that bumps SLO. any options to minimize?

alex: options considered: 1) inline gateway shim (fast, local, still +~5-30ms depending), 2) sidecar adapter (local but separate process, slightly more), 3) client adapter library (zero server latency, requires client rollout). For us, gateway shim seems best balance.

alex: example naive translation rules (pseudo):
```
if req.path == "/v1/chat" and tenant.flags.v1_to_v2 == true:
  new_body = {
    "model": map_model(req.body.model),
    "messages": convert_messages(req.body.input),
    "stream": req.body.stream || false
  }
  forward_to = "/v2/chat"
```

nina: we should also map errors back to v1 shapes. small compatibility surface: streaming frames, partial responses, role names.

sofia: +1 on error mapping. also think about observability: mark translated requests with header `X-RW-Translated: v1->v2` and include `X-RW-Orig-Model` for profiling.

deploy-bot: deploy check: gateway-shim branch builds OK, integration tests failing 2/14. See CI link: https://ci.internal/1234

jamie: thanks bot. alex can you add a perf test that measures p50/p95/p99 for small chat (64 tokens) with shim on/off? we should quantify.

alex: yes will add perf harness. also plan to add a phased telemetry flag to sample 1% full payloads for the first 2 weeks to catch edge cases.

nina: privacy note — for sampled payloads we need DPO sign-off for retention. i'll loop in @legal.

sofia: small nit — prefer header name `X-RW-Compat` instead of generic. makes queries easier.

alex: noted. decision items summarized: [1] implement gateway shim default-off, tenant opt-in; [2] translation header `X-RW-Compat: v1->v2`; [3] error/back-translate layer; [4] perf and staging rollout plan; [5] sample telemetry + legal sign-off. i'll open a tracker RFC + tasks.

jamie: sounds good. ping me on the RFC when ready, i'll review the perf tests. :thumbsup:

nina: will help with error mapping matrix.

sofia: will add observable dashboards for translated traffic.

alex: thanks all — i'll file RFC and link here shortly.
